lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, averaging approximately 25-40 pixels between segments, with slight convergence at the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Y-shaped topological bifurcations are visible on the 8th line segment from the posterior (ventral split) and the 11th line segment (dorsal split).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (far posterior) and line 6 exhibit mid-torso termination; line 13 is a truncated segment near the anterior shoulder boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated white spots observed on the lower haunch and upper hind limb; density is insufficient to constitute a cluster grouping.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct circular white spots on the lower malar region of the face; white transverse band visible on the muzzle bridge; white patch located on the ventral neck/throat transition.
